name: GlideTime
title: GlideTime - Scoped
summary: The GlideTime API provides methods for performing operations on GlideTime objects, such as instantiating GlideTime objects or working with GlideTime fields.
overview: For guidance on date time input strings with a list of common format conflicts, refer to Date and time format guidelines.

members.name: GlideTime
members.summary: Instantiates a GlideTime object with its time starting at midnight UTC plus the passed in value.
members.html:
The value is adjusted for the timezone in which the instance resides. For example, if the user's instance is in a time zone that is -8 hours from the UTC, and 1000 is passed in, the time in the GlideTime object is 16:00:10 (00:00:00 - 8 hours +10 seconds.)

Parameters
Name Type Description
milliseconds Number Time to add to midnight UTC.

Unit: Milliseconds

This example shows adding 10 seconds to midnight (UTC), which is then adjusted for the time zone in which the instance resides. In this case, -8 hours from UTC.

var gt = new GlideTime(10000); 
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValue());

Output:

16:00:10

members.name: getByFormat
members.summary: Returns the time in the specified format.
members.html:
For information on the time formats that you can pass into this method, see Global date and time field format. You can pass these values in any order and add separators such as a dash, space, backslash, or colon. In addition, you can also pass the character "a" to return am/pm.

Parameters
Name Type Description
format String String to use to format the time.
For example, if the current time is 10:30:20 then:
  • hh:mm:ss = 10:30:20
  • HH = 10
  • HH –- ss = 10 –- 20
  • hh a = 10 AM
  • s:m:H ss:mm:hh = 20:30:10 20:30:10
  • HH/mm/ss = 10/30/20
Returns
Type Description
String Time in the specified format. 
var gt = new GlideTime(); 
gt.setValue('12:00:00');
gs.info(gt.getByFormat("HH:mm"));
Output: 
12:00

members.name: getDisplayValue
members.summary: Gets the time in the current user's display format and time zone.
members.html:
When designing business rules or script includes remember that this method may return values in different formats for different users.

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String The time in the user's format and time zone. 
var gt = new GlideTime();
gt.setDisplayValue("12:00:00"); // User Time Zone
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValue()); // User Time Zone

members.name: getDisplayValueEx
members.summary: Returns the time using the current user's timezone and a specified format.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
style String Format to use for the time.
Valid values (case insensitive):
  • short: HH:mm (AM/PM)
  • medium: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM)
  • long: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone abbreviation
  • full: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone

The time is returned in the current user's language. The language determines whether the time is returned in 12 hour or 24 hour format.
Returns
Type Description
String The time in the specified format.

This example returns the time using the current user's timezone and each formatting option.

var gt = new GlideTime();
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValueEx("short"));
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValueEx("medium"));
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValueEx("long"));
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValueEx("full"));

Output:

8:52 AM  //short
8:52:24 AM  //medium
8:52:24 AM PST  //long
8:52:24 AM Pacific Standard Time  //full

members.name: getDisplayValueInternal
members.summary: Gets the display value in the current user's time zone and the internal format (HH:mm:ss).
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description

members.name: getDisplayValueLang
members.summary: Returns the time using the current user's timezone and a specified format and language.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
style String Format to use for the time.
Valid values (case insensitive):
  • short: HH:mm (AM/PM)
  • medium: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM)
  • long: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone abbreviation
  • full: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone
language String Optional. Language to return the time in, provided as a BCP 47 language tag. For example, to return the time in Japanese use the tag ja.

The language determines whether the time is returned in 12 hour or 24 hour format. For example, times in English use the 12 hour format, while times in Japanese use the 24 hour format.

Default: Current user's language.
Returns
Type Description
String The time in the specified format and language.

This example returns the time in Spanish using the current user's timezone and each formatting option.

var gt = new GlideTime();
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValueLang("short", "es"));
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValueLang("medium", "es"));
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValueLang("long", "es"));
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValueLang("full", "es"));

Output:

9:25  //short
9:25:44  //medium
9:25:44 PST  //long
9:25:44 (hora estándar del Pacífico)  //full

members.name: setDisplayValueEx
members.summary: Sets the time using the current user's timezone and a specified format.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
time String Value to set for the time.
The getDisplayValueEx() method returns times in a valid format, or times can be formatted as shown below.
  • HH:mm (AM/PM)
  • HH:mm:ss (AM/PM)
  • HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone abbreviation
  • HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone
The current user's language determines whether 12 hour (AM/PM) or 24 hour time values are accepted. For example, if the current user's language is English 6:25 PM PST is a valid value while 18:25 PST is not.
style String Format to use for the time.

You must use the same format as the provided time value.

Valid values (case insensitive):
  • short: HH:mm (AM/PM)
  • medium: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM)
  • long: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone abbreviation
  • full: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone
Returns
Type Description
None

This example sets the time using the current user's timezone and a specified format.

gt = new GlideTime();
gt.setDisplayValueEx("8:25:25 AM", "medium");
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValueEx("full"));

Output:

8:25:25 AM Pacific Standard Time

members.name: setDisplayValueLang
members.sig: setDisplayValueLang(String time, String style, String language)
members.summary: Sets the time using the current user's timezone and a specified format and language.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
time String Value to set for the time.
The getDisplayValueLang() and getDisplayValueEx() methods return times in a valid format, or times can be formatted as shown below.
  • HH:mm (AM/PM)
  • HH:mm:ss (AM/PM)
  • HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone abbreviation
  • HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone
The language parameter determines whether 12 hour (AM/PM) or 24 hour time values are accepted. For example, if the language is en (English), 6:25 PM PST is a valid value while 18:25 PST is not.
style String Format to use for the time.

You must use the same format as the provided time value.

Valid values (case insensitive):
  • short: HH:mm (AM/PM)
  • medium: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM)
  • long: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone abbreviation
  • full: HH:mm:ss (AM/PM) timezone
language String Language to set the time in, provided as a BCP 47 language tag. For example, to set the time in Japanese, use the tag ja.
Returns
Type Description
None

This example sets the time in English using the current user's timezone and retrieves it in Spanish.

gt = new GlideTime();
gt.setDisplayValueLang("4:15:00 PM PST", "long", "en");
gs.info(gt.getDisplayValueLang("full", "es"));

Output:

16:15:00 (hora estándar del Pacífico)

members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description

endTime GlideTime The end value.
Returns
Type Description
GlideDuration The duration between the two values. 
var gd1 = new GlideTime(); 
gd1.setDisplayValue("09:00:00"); 
var gd2 = new GlideTime();
